request.description:
# Agent Self Registration

Registers a new agent account in the RenewOne platform.

This endpoint allows a new agent to create an account using their basic personal and contact information. After successful registration, the agent can log in using the registered username and password.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/Account/register-agent`

---

## Authentication

**No Authentication Required**

---

## Supported Users

- Public (Guest Users)
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "agentName": "Manoj Nair",
    "userName": "manojnair76",
    "address": "Thodupuzha",
    "pincode": "685584",
    "contactNumber": "9744510308",
    "email": "manojnair76@gmail.com",
    "password": "password"
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| agentName | ✅ | Full name of the agent. |
| userName | ✅ | Unique username used for login. |
| address | ✅ | Agent's address. |
| pincode | ✅ | Postal PIN code. |
| contactNumber | ✅ | Mobile number of the agent. |
| email | ✅ | Valid email address. |
| password | ✅ | Password for the account. |

---

## Success Response (201)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": true,
    "message": "Agent registered successfully",
    "statusCode": 201,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication is **not required**.
    
- Username must be unique.
    
- Email address must be unique.
    
- Contact number must be unique.
    
- All mandatory fields must be provided.
    
- Password is securely encrypted before storage.
    
- Newly registered users are created with the **Agent** role.
    
- Newly registered agents cannot immediately log in using the registered credentials. Need admin approval.
    

---

## Validation Rules

| Field | Validation |
| --- | --- |
| agentName | Required |
| userName | Required, must be unique |
| address | Required |
| pincode | Required |
| contactNumber | Required, valid mobile number |
| email | Required, valid email format, must be unique |
| password | Required |

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or invalid request. |
| 401 | Not applicable. |
| 409 | Username, email, or contact number already exists. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Open Registration Page
          │
          ▼
Enter Agent Details
          │
          ▼
Submit Registration
          │
          ▼
Validate Request
          │
          ├──────── Validation Failed
          │              │
          │              ▼
          │        Return Validation Errors
          │
          ▼
Create Agent Account
          │
          ▼
Return Success (201)
          │
          ▼
Login using Username & Password

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is intended for **new agent registration** only.
    
- The registered username is used for future login.
    
- The password is stored securely using encryption/hashing.
    
- Duplicate usernames, email addresses, or contact numbers are not allowed.
    
- After successful registration, the user can authenticate using the **Login API**.

request.description:
# Approve Agent Registration

Approves a pending agent registration request.

Once approved, the agent account becomes active and the agent can log in to the RenewOne platform using their registered username and password.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/Account/approve-agent/{accountId}`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- Super Admin
    
- Admin Employee
    
- Supervisor
    

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| accountId | ✅ | Unique identifier of the pending agent account. |

---

## Example Request

``` http
POST /api/Account/approve-agent/44b0472c-924b-43f5-8bb6-b54e4ca80099

 ```

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": true,
    "message": "Agent approved successfully",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Agent Not Found (404)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": false,
    "data": false,
    "message": "Agent not found.",
    "statusCode": 404,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **Super Admin**, **Admin Employee**, and **Supervisor** users can approve agent registrations.
    
- The specified account must exist.
    
- The account must currently be in the **Pending** status.
    
- Once approved:
    
    - The account status changes to **Approved**.
        
    - The agent is allowed to log in to the system.
        
    - The approval action is recorded for auditing purposes.
        

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid account identifier or account cannot be approved. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to approve agents. |
| 404 | Agent not found. |
| 409 | Agent has already been approved. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Agent Self Registration
          │
          ▼
Registration Status = Pending
          │
          ▼
View Pending Agents
          │
          ▼
Approve Agent
          │
          ▼
Registration Status = Approved
          │
          ▼
Agent Login Enabled

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is used only for approving pending agent registrations.
    
- After approval, the agent can immediately authenticate using the Login API.
    
- The `accountId` should be obtained from the **Get Pending Agents** API.
    
- Attempting to approve an already approved account may result in a **409 Conflict** response.

request.description:
# Get Pending Agents

Retrieves the list of agent registration requests that are currently pending approval.

The results can be filtered using predefined date filters or by specifying a custom date.

---

## Endpoint

**GET** `/api/Account/pending-agents`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- SuperAdmin
    
- AdminEmployee
    
- Supervisor
    

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FilterType | ❌ | Date filter. Supported values are listed below. Default is `Today`. |
| CustomDate | ❌ | Required only when `FilterType = Custom`. Format: ISO 8601 UTC (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`). |

---

## Date Filter Values

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Today | Returns agents registered today. |
| 2 | Yesterday | Returns agents registered yesterday. |
| 3 | ThisWeek | Returns agents registered during the current week. |
| 4 | ThisMonth | Returns agents registered during the current month. |
| 5 | Custom | Returns agents registered on or after the specified `CustomDate`. |

You can also use the enum names instead of numeric values if supported by the API:

```
Today
Yesterday
ThisWeek
ThisMonth
Custom

 ```

---

## Example Requests

### Today's Pending Agents

``` http
GET /api/Account/pending-agents?FilterType=Today

 ```

or

``` http
GET /api/Account/pending-agents?FilterType=1

 ```

---

### This Week

``` http
GET /api/Account/pending-agents?FilterType=ThisWeek

 ```

---

### Custom Date

``` http
GET /api/Account/pending-agents?FilterType=Custom&CustomDate=2026-07-11T11:12:19.075Z

 ```

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": [
        {
            "accountId": "44b0472c-924b-43f5-8bb6-b54e4ca80099",
            "agentName": "Manoj Nair",
            "email": "manojnair76@gmail.com",
            "contactNumber": "9744510308",
            "address": null,
            "pincode": null,
            "requestedClass": "Basic",
            "createdAt": "2026-07-11T17:07:24.2207246"
        }
    ],
    "message": "Fetched pending agents successfully",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Empty Response

When no pending agents are found:

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": [],
    "message": "Fetched pending agents successfully",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response Fields

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| accountId | Unique account identifier. |
| agentName | Agent's full name. |
| email | Registered email address. |
| contactNumber | Agent's mobile number. |
| address | Agent's address. |
| pincode | Postal PIN code. |
| requestedClass | Requested agent class (e.g., Basic, Premium). |
| createdAt | Date and time when the registration request was submitted. |

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **SA**, **AE**, and **Supervisor** users can access this endpoint.
    
- Only agents whose registration status is **Pending** are returned.
    
- Date filtering is performed using the selected **FilterType**.
    
- `CustomDate` is required only when `FilterType` is **Custom**.
    
- If no pending agents match the filter, an empty list is returned.
    

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid filter type or custom date format. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to access pending agents. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Agent Self Registration
          │
          ▼
Registration Status = Pending
          │
          ▼
GET Pending Agents
          │
          ▼
Display Pending Agent List
          │
          ├── Approve
          └── Reject

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint returns only pending registrations.
    
- The frontend can use the returned `accountId` to approve or reject an agent registration.
    
- The endpoint supports both predefined date filters and a custom date filter.
    
- An empty array (`[]`) indicates that no pending registrations matched the selected filter.

request.description:
# Approve Payment

Approves a submitted payment after successful verification.

Once approved, the payment status is updated to **Approved**, allowing the policy issuance process to continue.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/PolicyPayment/approve`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- SuperAdmin
    
- AdminEmployee
    
- Supervisor
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "policyPaymentId": "cd0af16c-6654-474a-bb21-1d71dd8b3d8b",
    "remarks": "Approved"
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| policyPaymentId | ✅ | Unique identifier of the payment record. |
| remarks | ❌ | Approval remarks or notes. |

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": "cd0af16c-6654-474a-bb21-1d71dd8b3d8b",
    "message": "Payment approved successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response

The `data` field contains the approved **Policy Payment Id**.

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **Admin** and **Staff** users can approve payments.
    
- The payment record must exist.
    
- The payment must currently be in the **Pending** status.
    
- Once approved:
    
    - Payment status is updated to **Approved**.
        
    - Approval remarks are saved.
        
    - The enquiry proceeds to the next stage of policy processing.
        

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid request or payment cannot be approved. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to approve payments. |
| 404 | Payment record not found. |
| 409 | Payment has already been approved or processed. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Submit Policy Request
        │
        ▼
Payment Verification Pending
        │
        ▼
Review Payment
        │
        ├───────────────┐
        │               │
        ▼               ▼
Approve          Reject
        │
        ▼
Payment Status = Approved
        │
        ▼
Continue Policy Processing

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint should be called only after verifying the payment details.
    
- Once approved, the payment enters the **Approved** state and the policy issuance workflow can continue.
    
- Remarks are optional but recommended for audit purposes.

request.description:
# Reject Payment

Rejects a submitted payment after verification.

If the payment verification fails or the submitted payment details are invalid, the payment can be rejected. The rejection remarks are stored for audit purposes and displayed to the user.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/PolicyPayment/reject`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- SuperAdmin
    
- AdminEmployee
    
- Supervisor
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "policyPaymentId": "e8ac2f13-1132-f809-7a7e-18a74040d868",
    "remarks": "Payment screenshot is not clear."
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| policyPaymentId | ✅ | Unique identifier of the payment record. |
| remarks | ✅ | Reason for rejecting the payment. |

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": "e8ac2f13-1132-f809-7a7e-18a74040d868",
    "message": "Payment rejected successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response

The `data` field contains the rejected **Policy Payment Id**.

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- The payment record must exist.
    
- The payment must currently be in the **Pending** status.
    
- Rejection remarks are mandatory.
    
- Once rejected:
    
    - Payment status is updated to **Rejected**.
        
    - The rejection remarks are stored.
        
    - The enquiry remains pending until the customer submits a new payment request.
        

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or payment cannot be rejected. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to reject payments. |
| 404 | Payment record not found. |
| 409 | Payment has already been processed. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Submit Policy Request
        │
        ▼
Payment Verification Pending
        │
        ▼
Review Payment
        │
        ├───────────────┐
        │               │
        ▼               ▼
Approve          Reject
                        │
                        ▼
              Payment Status = Rejected
                        │
                        ▼
          Customer submits payment again
                        │
                        ▼
           Payment Verification Pending

 ```

---

## Notes

- Rejection remarks should clearly explain why the payment was rejected.
    
- After rejection, the customer or agent should submit a new payment with the corrected details.
    
- Every rejection is recorded for audit and tracking purposes.

request.description:
# Get Payment QR Details

Retrieves the payment QR details associated with the specified enquiry.

This endpoint is used by the Agent application to display the QR code or bank account details for payment.

If no QR mapping has been configured for the enquiry, the API returns **404 - QR Mapping not found**.

---

## Endpoint

**GET** `/api/PolicyPayment/{enquiryId}/qr`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- Agent
    
- Staff
    

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enquiryId | ✅ | Unique identifier of the enquiry. |

---

## Example Request

``` http
GET /api/PolicyPayment/3AE3ECEA-BFA4-4AB1-A8D0-A3DEA32DBBD3/qr

 ```

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": {
        "qrMasterId": "751f27ac-8312-47d3-a66c-42e0753ed57f",
        "qrName": "Bike UPI",
        "qrImageUrl": "",
        "bankAccountId": "3cc0921c-ea26-4b34-b0aa-face397a9f40",
        "bankName": "SBI",
        "branchName": "Ernakulam",
        "accountHolderName": "Arun",
        "accountNumber": "12100100077431",
        "ifscCode": "SBIN0070564",
        "upiId": "arun@upi"
    },
    "message": "QR details fetched successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response Fields

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| qrMasterId | QR master identifier. |
| qrName | Display name of the QR. |
| qrImageUrl | QR image URL to display in the application. |
| bankAccountId | Linked bank account identifier. |
| bankName | Bank name. |
| branchName | Bank branch name. |
| accountHolderName | Account holder's name. |
| accountNumber | Bank account number. |
| ifscCode | IFSC code of the bank account. |
| upiId | UPI ID associated with the QR. |

---

## QR Mapping Not Found (404)

If no QR mapping is configured for the enquiry, the API returns:

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": false,
    "data": null,
    "message": "QR Mapping not found.",
    "statusCode": 404,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **Agent** and **Staff** users can access this endpoint.
    
- The enquiry must exist.
    
- The enquiry must be eligible for payment.
    
- A QR mapping must be configured for the enquiry.
    
- If a QR mapping exists, the API returns the QR details and bank account information.
    
- If no QR mapping exists, the API returns **404 - QR Mapping not found**.
    

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid enquiry identifier. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to access this resource. |
| 404 | QR mapping not found for the specified enquiry. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Policy Request Submitted
          │
          ▼
Fetch Payment QR
          │
          ├──────────── QR Mapping Exists ─────────────┐
          │                                            │
          ▼                                            ▼
Display QR Image                               Display Bank Details
          │                                            │
          └──────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                                 ▼
                         Agent Makes Payment
                                 │
                                 ▼
                     Submit Payment Transaction

 ```

---

## Frontend Behaviour

### When Status Code = 200

- Display the QR image if `qrImageUrl` is available.
    
- Display the bank details:
    
    - Bank Name
        
    - Branch Name
        
    - Account Holder Name
        
    - Account Number
        
    - IFSC Code
        
    - UPI ID
        
- Allow the agent to proceed with payment.
    

### When Status Code = 404

Display a user-friendly message such as:

> **Payment QR is currently unavailable. Please contact the administrator or try again later.** 
  

The frontend should disable the payment action until a valid QR mapping is configured.

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is read-only.
    
- It provides the payment information required before the agent submits the payment request.
    
- If both a QR image and bank details are available, the frontend should display both to provide multiple payment options.

# Create Vehicle Enquiry

Creates a new vehicle insurance enquiry by validating the vehicle number and fetching vehicle details from the RC service.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/VehicleEnquiry/create-vehicle-enquiry`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- SuperAdmin
    
- AdminEmployee
    
- Supervisor
    
- Agent
    
- Staff
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "insuranceTypeId": "C3F8D2AB-67F9-45E0-A0DC-6967910D9C02",
    "vehicleTypeId": "FAE3BB60-CC05-4E76-BBC6-97D2EC616125",
    "customerName": "Gokul",
    "customerNumber": "9961362697",
    "vehicleNumber": "KL38G8783",
    "miPolicyType": "ThirdParty",
    "isRCOwnerChanged": false,
    "hasPreviousClaim": false,
    "ncbPercentage": 0,
    "priority": 1,
    "submissionMode": 1
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| insuranceTypeId | ✅ | Insurance Type identifier. |
| vehicleTypeId | ✅ | Vehicle Type identifier. |
| customerName | ✅ | Customer's full name. |
| customerNumber | ✅ | Customer mobile number. |
| vehicleNumber | ✅ | Vehicle registration number. |
| miPolicyType | ✅ | Motor insurance policy type. |
| isRCOwnerChanged | ✅ | Indicates whether the RC ownership has changed. |
| hasPreviousClaim | ✅ | Indicates whether the vehicle has any previous insurance claims. |
| ncbPercentage | ✅ | No Claim Bonus percentage. Use **0** if no NCB is applicable. |
| priority | ✅ | Enquiry priority. Currently only **1** is supported. |
| submissionMode | ✅ | Indicates how the enquiry was created. |

---

## MI Policy Type

Supported values:

- `OwnDamaged`
    
- `Comprehensive`
    
- `ThirdParty`
    

---

## Submission Mode

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | API |
| 2 | Manual |

---

## Priority

Currently only one priority level is supported.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Normal |

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": {
        "enquiryId": "3ae3ecea-bfa4-4ab1-a8d0-a3dea32dbbd3",
        "brand": "India Yamaha Motor Pvt Ltd",
        "model": "Yamaha Fz Fi With Gear Bs Iv",
        "manufactureYear": "10/2018",
        "cubicCapacity": "149.0",
        "fuelType": "Petrol",
        "submissionType": "TP"
    },
    "message": "Vehicle enquiry successfully registered.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or invalid request. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to perform this operation. |
| 404 | Vehicle details could not be retrieved from the RC service. |
| 409 | Enquiry already exists. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- The vehicle registration number must be valid.
    
- Vehicle information is automatically fetched from the configured RC service.
    
- Customer name and mobile number are mandatory.
    
- `miPolicyType` must be one of:
    
    - `OwnDamaged`
        
    - `Comprehensive`
        
    - `ThirdParty`
        
- `priority` should currently always be **1**.
    
- `submissionMode` should be:
    
    - **1** when the enquiry is created through the application.
        
    - **2** when the enquiry is entered manually.
        
- The generated `enquiryId` should be used for all subsequent operations such as document upload, quote creation, payment, and policy generation.
    

---

## Notes

- Vehicle brand, model, fuel type, manufacture year, and cubic capacity are retrieved from the RC service.
    
- The API returns the generated **Enquiry ID**, which uniquely identifies the enquiry throughout its lifecycle.

# Upload Vehicle Documents

Uploads a document associated with an existing vehicle enquiry.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/VehicleEnquiry/upload-docs`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- All Roles
    

---

## Content Type

`multipart/form-data`

---

## Form Data

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EnquiryId | Text | ✅ | Unique enquiry identifier returned from the **Create Vehicle Enquiry** API. |
| DocType | Text | ✅ | Type of document being uploaded. See supported values below. |
| DocSide | Text | ✅ | Indicates whether the uploaded document is the front or back side. See supported values below. |
| File | File | ✅ | Document file to upload. Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, PDF. |

---

## Supported Document Types

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| RC | Registration Certificate |
| Aadhaar | Aadhaar Card |
| PAN | PAN Card |
| DrivingLicense | Driving License |
| PreviousPolicy | Previous Insurance Policy |

> **Note:** Upload only the document types applicable to the selected insurance policy. 
  

---

## Supported Document Sides

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Front | Front side of the document |
| Back | Back side of the document |

For single-page documents (for example, Previous Policy PDF), use **Front**.

---

## Example Request

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EnquiryId | 3AE3ECEA-BFA4-4AB1-A8D0-A3DEA32DBBD3 |
| DocType | RC |
| DocSide | Front |
| File | RC_Front.jpg |

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": "8253c1cf-1da8-48d7-91d9-a999613a7adb",
    "message": "Document uploaded successfully",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response

The API returns the uploaded **Document Id**.

This identifier can be used internally for document management and future operations.

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or invalid request. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to upload documents. |
| 404 | Enquiry not found. |
| 413 | Uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size. |
| 415 | Unsupported file type. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Business Rules

- A valid **EnquiryId** is required.
    
- The enquiry must exist.
    
- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is mandatory.
    
- Upload one document per request.
    
- The uploaded file must match the selected **DocType**.
    
- Front and Back documents should be uploaded separately.
    
- Previous Policy documents may be uploaded as a single PDF using **DocSide = Front**.
    
- Documents are securely stored and linked to the specified enquiry.
    

---

## Upload Sequence

A typical document upload flow is:

1. Create Vehicle Enquiry
    
2. Receive `EnquiryId`
    
3. Upload RC Front
    
4. Upload RC Back
    
5. Upload Aadhaar Front
    
6. Upload Aadhaar Back
    
7. Upload PAN (if required)
    
8. Upload Previous Policy (if applicable)
    

---

## Notes

- Use `multipart/form-data`.
    
- Do **not** send the request body as JSON.
    
- The `File` field must be of type **File**.
    
- Ensure the document image is clear and readable before uploading.

request.description:
# Submit Vehicle Enquiry

Submits a vehicle enquiry for quote generation.

Based on the selected **MI Policy Type** and the available pricing configuration, the enquiry will either move directly to the **Quoted** stage or remain in the **Submitted** stage for manual processing.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/VehicleEnquiry/submit-vehicle-enquiry`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- Agent
    
- Staff
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "enquiryId": "3AE3ECEA-BFA4-4AB1-A8D0-A3DEA32DBBD3"
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enquiryId | ✅ | Unique enquiry identifier returned from the Create Vehicle Enquiry API. |

---

## Success Response (Quoted)

Returned when:

- MI Policy Type is **ThirdParty**
    
- Matching pricing exists in the Pricing Master for the vehicle.
    

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": {
        "enquiryId": "3ae3ecea-bfa4-4ab1-a8d0-a3dea32dbbd3",
        "status": "Quoted",
        "redirectToQuotes": true
    },
    "message": "Quotes generated successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Success Response (Submitted)

Returned when:

- MI Policy Type is **OwnDamaged** or **Comprehensive**, **OR**
    
- No matching Third Party pricing is available.
    

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": {
        "enquiryId": "3ae3ecea-bfa4-4ab1-a8d0-a3dea32dbbd3",
        "status": "Submitted",
        "redirectToQuotes": false
    },
    "message": "Vehicle enquiry submitted successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Status Flow

| Condition | Status | Redirect To Quotes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MI Policy Type = ThirdParty and matching pricing exists | Quoted | ✅ true |
| MI Policy Type = ThirdParty but no matching pricing exists | Submitted | ❌ false |
| MI Policy Type = OwnDamaged | Submitted | ❌ false |
| MI Policy Type = Comprehensive | Submitted | ❌ false |

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **Agent** and **Staff** users can access this endpoint.
    
- The enquiry must exist.
    
- The enquiry must not have already been submitted.
    
- If the **MI Policy Type** is **ThirdParty**, the system searches the Pricing Master for a matching record based on the vehicle details.
    
- When a matching pricing record is found:
    
    - Quotes are generated automatically.
        
    - Enquiry status is updated to **Quoted**.
        
    - `redirectToQuotes` is returned as **true**.
        
- If no matching pricing record is found:
    
    - The enquiry status is updated to **Submitted**.
        
    - `redirectToQuotes` is returned as **false**.
        
- Own Damaged and Comprehensive enquiries always proceed to the Submitted stage for manual quotation.
    

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or invalid request. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to perform this action. |
| 404 | Enquiry not found. |
| 409 | Enquiry has already been submitted. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Create Vehicle Enquiry
          │
          ▼
Upload Documents
          │
          ▼
Submit Vehicle Enquiry
          │
          ├────────────── ThirdParty ──────────────┐
          │                                        │
          │                          Pricing Found?│
          │                                        │
          │                               Yes      │      No
          │                                │       │
          ▼                                ▼       ▼
      Quoted                       Auto Generate  Submitted
      redirectToQuotes = true        Quotes

 ```

---

## Notes

- `redirectToQuotes = true` indicates that the frontend should navigate directly to the Quotes page.
    
- `redirectToQuotes = false` indicates that the enquiry has been submitted and is awaiting manual quote generation.
    
- The response status determines the next step in the enquiry workflow.

request.description:
# Submit Policy Request

Submits a selected insurance quote for policy issuance.

Before submitting the request, the system validates that all mandatory documents required for the selected insurance type have been uploaded.

If any required document is missing, the request is rejected and the response contains the list of missing documents.

---

## Endpoint

**POST** `/api/VehicleEnquiry/submit-policy-request`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- Agent
    
- Staff
    

---

## Request Body

``` json
{
    "quoteId": "7D4B1F5D-500F-4B15-B224-541065B3980D",
    "enquiryId": "3AE3ECEA-BFA4-4AB1-A8D0-A3DEA32DBBD3",
    "useLedger": false,
    "transactionId": "TESTTRANSACTION",
    "remarks": "TEST"
}

 ```

---

## Request Parameters

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| quoteId | ✅ | Selected quote identifier. |
| enquiryId | ✅ | Enquiry identifier. |
| useLedger | ✅ | Indicates whether the customer's ledger balance should be used for payment. |
| transactionId | ❌ | Payment transaction reference. Required when payment is made outside the ledger. |
| remarks | ❌ | Additional remarks or notes. |

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": "0f894812-c7d7-469e-b42a-3e39de9b2931",
    "message": "Policy submitted successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

### Response

The `data` field contains the generated **Policy Request Id**.

---

## Validation Response (Missing Documents)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": false,
    "data": null,
    "message": "Missing Documents: Previous Policy",
    "statusCode": 400,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

If multiple documents are missing, all missing document names are returned in the message.

Example:

``` text
Missing Documents: RC Back, Aadhaar Front, Previous Policy

 ```

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **Agent** and **Staff** users can submit a policy request.
    
- A valid **Quote** must be selected.
    
- The selected quote must belong to the specified enquiry.
    
- Before policy submission, the system verifies that all mandatory documents have been uploaded.
    
- If one or more mandatory documents are missing:
    
    - Policy submission is rejected.
        
    - HTTP Status **400** is returned.
        
    - The response message contains the list of missing documents.
        
- If all validations succeed:
    
    - A new Policy Request is created.
        
    - The enquiry proceeds to the policy processing stage.
        

---

## Mandatory Documents

The required documents depend on the insurance type and business rules.

Examples include:

- RC Front
    
- RC Back
    
- Aadhaar Front
    
- Aadhaar Back
    
- PAN Card
    
- Previous Policy
    

Only the documents applicable to the selected insurance type are validated.

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Validation failed or mandatory documents are missing. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to submit a policy request. |
| 404 | Enquiry or Quote not found. |
| 409 | Policy request has already been submitted. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Create Vehicle Enquiry
          │
          ▼
Upload Documents
          │
          ▼
Generate / Select Quote
          │
          ▼
Submit Policy Request
          │
          ├──────── Missing Documents
          │              │
          │              ▼
          │      Return 400 with missing document list
          │
          ▼
Policy Request Created

 ```

---

## Notes

- Upload all mandatory documents before submitting a policy request.
    
- The API performs document validation automatically.
    
- The returned Policy Request Id can be used for subsequent policy processing and tracking.

# Get Payment Verification Details

Retrieves the payment verification details for a submitted policy request associated with the specified enquiry.

This API is primarily used by the frontend to display the payment verification information while the enquiry is in the **PaymentVerificationPending** stage.

---

## Endpoint

**GET** `/api/VehicleEnquiry/{enquiryId}/payment-verification`

---

## Authentication

**Bearer Token Required**

---

## Supported Roles

- Admin
    
- Staff
    

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enquiryId | ✅ | Unique identifier of the enquiry. |

---

## Example Request

``` http
GET /api/VehicleEnquiry/3AE3ECEA-BFA4-4AB1-A8D0-A3DEA32DBBD3/payment-verification

 ```

---

## Success Response (200)

``` json
{
    "isSuccess": true,
    "data": {
        "policyPaymentId": "cd0af16c-6654-474a-bb21-1d71dd8b3d8b",
        "enquiryId": "3ae3ecea-bfa4-4ab1-a8d0-a3dea32dbbd3",
        "customerName": "Gokul",
        "customerNumber": "9961362697",
        "vehicleNumber": "KL38G8783",
        "premium": 1120.00,
        "paymentMode": "BankTransfer",
        "transactionId": "TESTTRANSACTION",
        "paymentStatus": "Pending",
        "submittedAt": "2026-07-11T16:45:08.6178505",
        "submittedBy": "Anand Asokan",
        "remarks": "TEST"
    },
    "message": "Payment verification details retrieved successfully.",
    "statusCode": 200,
    "errors": null
}

 ```

---

## Response Fields

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| policyPaymentId | Unique payment record identifier. |
| enquiryId | Enquiry identifier. |
| customerName | Customer's full name. |
| customerNumber | Customer mobile number. |
| vehicleNumber | Vehicle registration number. |
| premium | Premium amount submitted for payment. |
| paymentMode | Mode of payment used. |
| transactionId | Payment transaction reference. |
| paymentStatus | Current payment verification status. |
| submittedAt | Date and time the payment request was submitted. |
| submittedBy | User who submitted the payment request. |
| remarks | Additional remarks provided during submission. |

---

## Business Rules

- Authentication using a valid **Bearer Token** is required.
    
- Only **SuperAdmin** , **Supervisor** and **AdminEmployee** users can access this endpoint.
    
- The enquiry must exist.
    
- This API is intended to be used when the enquiry status is **PaymentVerificationPending**.
    
- Returns the latest payment verification information associated with the enquiry.
    
- Payment verification is performed by the back-office team before policy issuance.
    

---

## Payment Status

Possible values include:

- Pending
    
- Verified
    
- Rejected
    

---

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Invalid enquiry identifier. |
| 401 | Unauthorized. Authentication token is missing or invalid. |
| 403 | User does not have permission to access this resource. |
| 404 | Enquiry or payment record not found. |
| 500 | Internal server error. |

---

## Workflow

``` text
Create Vehicle Enquiry
        │
        ▼
Upload Documents
        │
        ▼
Generate / Select Quote
        │
        ▼
Submit Policy Request
        │
        ▼
Payment Verification Pending
        │
        ▼
GET Payment Verification Details
        │
        ├── Pending
        ├── Verified
        └── Rejected

 ```

---

## Notes

- This endpoint is **read-only**.
    
- It provides the latest payment verification information for display in the frontend.
    
- The frontend should call this endpoint only when the enquiry status is **PaymentVerificationPending**.
    
- Once the payment is verified, the enquiry proceeds to the policy issuance process.
